description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for managing accounting rules within the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for retrieving templates, listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting accounting rules, along with internal methods for handling template data and tags.

classes.name: AccountingRuleApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing accounting rules, including endpoints for CRUD operations and template retrieval.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Returns a template for creating or editing accounting rules, including allowed accounts, offices, and tags.

methods.name: retrieveAllAccountingRules
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all accounting rules accessible to the current user.

methods.name: retreiveAccountingRule
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific accounting rule by ID, optionally returning a template version.

methods.name: createAccountingRule
methods.description: Creates a new accounting rule based on provided data.

methods.name: updateAccountingRule
methods.description: Updates an existing accounting rule identified by ID.

methods.name: deleteAccountingRule
methods.description: Deletes an accounting rule by ID.

methods.name: handleTemplate
methods.description: Prepares template data including allowed accounts, offices, and tags, optionally merging with existing data.

methods.name: retrieveSelectedTags
methods.description: Filters and retrieves selected tags from allowed options based on existing tag data.
